# Critical Issues Checklist: Backend Security & Judge Correctness

**Purpose**: Validate that the backend's requirements cover the critical security, trust-boundary, and judge-correctness issues identified in the code audit — before any implementation work begins.
**Created**: 2026-08-02
**Feature**: No spec.md exists for the backend; requirements below are derived from the full backend audit (security & integrity + judge correctness findings). This checklist tests whether each critical requirement is documented, clear, consistent, and measurable.

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Status**: All items resolved 2026-08-02 across branches `fix/backend-security-critical`, `fix/backend-judge-correctness`, `fix/backend-match-integrity`. Requirement registry with acceptance criteria: `SECURITY.md`.

## Security & Trust Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 Judging is server-side: `submit-solution` ignores client `testcases`/`expected` and fetches `Problem` from DB (`socket/index.js`), judge_type flows to the executor. [REQ-SEC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Socket.io handshake requires a valid JWT (`authenticateSocket` middleware); identity derives from the token, never from client events. [REQ-SEC-002]
- [x] CHK003 Submissions rejected unless `socket.user_id` is a player of the room. [REQ-SEC-003]
- [x] CHK004 `.env` ignored, `backend/.env.example` added (unignored via `!.env.example`); git-tracked secrets confirmed absent. [REQ-SEC-004]
- [x] CHK005 Password hash excluded from all serialization via `defaultScope` + `toJSON` on User model; login uses `unscoped()`. [REQ-SEC-005]
- [x] CHK006 `/user/update` enforces `req.user.id === id` (403 otherwise). [REQ-SEC-006]
- [x] CHK007 `/user/get-matches` requires auth and reads `req.user.id`. [REQ-SEC-007]
- [x] CHK008 Every route classified public / authenticated / internal and enforced (internalAuth on `/problem/add`, `/match/create-match`, `/submit`; auth on `/run`, `/user/update`, `/user/get-matches`). [REQ-SEC-008]
- [x] CHK009 Auth endpoints rate limited (20/15min), executor endpoints 10/min. [REQ-SEC-009]
- [x] CHK010 Threat model documented in `SECURITY.md` with per-threat mitigations; requirements trace to it. [REQ-SEC-010]

## Judge Correctness (Code Execution)

- [x] CHK011 Full judge path verified end-to-end for python and cpp (compile/run, normalize, compare, verdict); smoke-tested in Docker. [REQ-JUDGE-001]
- [x] CHK012 Shared `normalizer.sh` applied consistently to both languages for all judge types (`string`, `ignore_case`, `boolean`, `float`); `normalizer.py` made robust. [REQ-JUDGE-002]
- [x] CHK013 Per-language resource budgets (python 256m/0.5cpu/10s; cpp 512m/1cpu/20s). [REQ-JUDGE-003]
- [x] CHK014 Pass/fail driven by explicit `VERDICT:` lines, not exit status; cpp `$STATUS` dereference fixed. [REQ-JUDGE-004]
- [x] CHK015 C++ compile budget (10s) distinct from run budget (4s) inside `run.sh`. [REQ-JUDGE-005]
- [x] CHK016 Sandbox on all flows: `--network=none`, `--cap-drop=ALL`, `--pids-limit=64`, non-root `--user`, 1MB stdout cap; writable workdir for judge user. [REQ-JUDGE-006]
- [x] CHK017 Missing verdict surfaces as 5xx (`status: 500`) — never a pass/fail verdict. [REQ-JUDGE-007]

## Match Integrity & Lifecycle

- [x] CHK018 `match.finalized` flag guards exactly-once finalization under concurrency. [REQ-MATCH-001]
- [x] CHK019 `handleMatchTimeout` terminates on `time-up`: winner = approved player, draw if equal, Elo + persistence + `match-ended` emitted, match removed. [REQ-MATCH-002]
- [x] CHK020 Disconnect removes user from the matchmaking queue (`bucketQueue.remove` in disconnect handler). [REQ-MATCH-003]
- [x] CHK021 Candidates verified connected before `createMatch`; dead sockets re-queued and retried. [REQ-MATCH-004]
- [x] CHK022 Room state single-sourced in `MatchManager`; `match.controller` delegates to it. [REQ-MATCH-005]
- [x] CHK023 Rating bounds clamped in `BucketQueue.enqueue`; matchmaking payload validated against authenticated identity; no uncaught handler exceptions. [REQ-MATCH-006]
- [x] CHK024 Finalization failure reverts `finalized`, resets submitted state, and notifies the client instead of silently ending the match. [REQ-NFR-001]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 All socket handlers wrapped in try/catch; input validated at entry points. [REQ-NFR-001]
- [x] CHK026 Bucket-based matching bounded at 200 buckets of lookahead (was O(n log n) per call); tested in `tests/matchmaking/bucket-queue.test.js`. [REQ-NFR-002]
- [x] CHK027 Lifecycle cleanup: bucket nodes removed on match/leave/disconnect, match rooms ended on finalize/time-up/disconnect, temp dir swept at startup, random temp filenames. [REQ-NFR-003]
- [x] CHK028 Rate limits quantified per endpoint class (auth 20/15min, executor 10/min). [REQ-NFR-003]
- [x] CHK029 Scaling assumption (single instance, in-memory state) documented in `SECURITY.md`. [REQ-NFR-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality & Traceability

- [x] CHK030 Acceptance criteria defined for every REQ-* entry in `SECURITY.md`. [Traceability]
- [x] CHK031 Requirement-ID scheme established (REQ-SEC/JUDGE/MATCH/NFR). [Traceability]
- [x] CHK032 Recovery/exception scenarios (judge failure, DB failure, disconnect, concurrent submission, timeout) explicitly listed with in-scope behavior. [Coverage]
